descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S12 「在界面上走重新分配表：再分给同一个病人、加了字（重新分配之前不放上去），然后另一个病人」 Re-assign table through the UI: same patient again, words added (not placed until re-assigned), then another patient

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Re-assign works: re-assigning a box to a different patient adds its text to the new patient's encounter note and leaves it in the first patient's note. …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 6；TFA-92582 step 6）
  • T2 If more is dictated into a box after it was assigned, only the new words are added when it is assigned again.（TFA-92582 AC 6；TFA-92582 step 7）
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 5；TFA-92582 step 5；TFA-92583 AC 4）
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 2；TFA-92583 AC 2）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given QA Hosp Abbott (501) and QA Hosp Baker (502), both with empty encounter notes

When Box 'Wound check: clean, dry, intact.' → Abbott; Re-assign → Abbott again (nothing new); replace the text with 'Wound check: clean, dry, intact. Ambulating in the hall.' and close the pad without re-assigning; open Abbott's chart; reopen the pad; Re-assign → Abbott; Re-assign → Baker

Then The added words do not reach Abbott's chart on their own and stay in the box; after the re-assign Abbott has the first sentence once and the added words once; Baker has the whole box; Abbott keeps its copy after the move to Baker

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp2 Abbott's Encounter mustContain 'Wound check: clean, dry, intact.' exactly once, mustNotContain 'Ambulating in the hall' (added words never go to the chart by themselves — that would be auto-assignment, U6/T2). cp3 the reopened pad still holds the whole text (U4); whether anything says the added words are not on the chart is recorded for Q13. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U18；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
